---
name: Data broker people-search opt-out
description: >-
  Use for US people-search free opt-outs; Eraser; Fresh-project; GitHub
  companions sync; Needs-you handoffs.
---
Generic process for **free listing suppression** on US people-search / data-broker sites. **Do not put subject PII in this skill** — pull identity from the user or private notes.

## Full companions (GitHub — required on template import)

Public repo: https://github.com/natv/grokbot-data-broker-removal

**Always prefer the newest companions** — do not hard-pin forever to one tag. Resolve the ref in this order:

1. **Latest GitHub Release** — `GET https://api.github.com/repos/natv/grokbot-data-broker-removal/releases/latest` and use `tag_name` (or open the releases/latest zip redirect).
2. If that fails (no releases / network): branch **`main`**.
3. Fallbacks only if newer refs fail: tags **`v1.0.1`**, then **`v1.0.0`**.

Raw base once you have `{ref}`:
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/natv/grokbot-data-broker-removal/{ref}/companions/`

Zip:
`https://github.com/natv/grokbot-data-broker-removal/archive/refs/tags/{tag}.zip` (or `…/archive/refs/heads/main.zip` for main).

On Fresh-project / getting-started **before Session A**, sync into this skill folder (`data-broker-people-search-opt-out/`):

1. Resolve `{ref}` with the order above; note which ref you used.
2. Check `master-catalog.csv` — need ~500+ data rows. If missing/thin, download the zip for that ref **or** curl each file from the raw base: `master-catalog.csv`, `quirks.md`, `session-plan.md`, `mail-setup.md`, `networks.md`, `identity-pack-template.md`, `sharing-and-onboarding.md`, `sources-inventory.md`, `playbook.md`, `MANIFEST.json`.
3. Optionally replace a thin embedded playbook with downloaded `playbook.md` for full long-form rules.
4. Verify catalog + quirks + session-plan are non-trivial; read MANIFEST version when present.
5. Keep attribution: Optery / Yael **CC BY-NC-SA 4.0**; Eraser **MIT**.

Companion skills in this template may be thin pointers; GitHub files after sync are authoritative. When the public repo gains `v1.0.2` / `v1.0.3` / later releases, **new imports and Fresh-project syncs pick them up automatically** via latest-release — no template restage required for companion bumps alone.

## What to expect (tell the human up front)

The **human still participates**: phone codes, hard CAPTCHAs, confirm links on their phone, optional ID uploads, later Local execution for Cloudflare.
The **agent**: listing search, free forms, solvable CAPTCHAs, inbox confirms; Chrome + Firefox ESR; prefer email/form over phone; never pay; ask tracker preference before Session A; keep Needs-you and Cloudflare lists; Tier-1 first; finishing ~537 rows is optional; offer routines only if they say yes.

## HARD — preserve confirmation-inbox unread

1. Prefer metadata/search/snippets; fetch bodies only when needed.
2. Before body fetch, note unread; after, restore UNREAD if the connector cleared it.
3. Eraser IMAP: BODY.PEEK (`Peek: true`). Stock Eraser without Peek marks recent INBOX read.
4. Never bulk-scan the whole INBOX.
5. Archiving handled broker mail is fine.

## Legal / residency

Ask residency before templates: most US non-CA → universal free suppression; CA → CCPA/DROP + `ccpa`; EU/UK → `gdpr`. Opt-out ≠ county/court originals; recheck 30–45 days, then ~twice yearly.

## Tracker setup (ask before Session A)

Widget when available: Google Sheets | Excel M365/OneDrive | agent-only local | other they name. Columns: Broker, Tier, Network, Status, Opt-out URL, Submitted, Confirm, Notes, Method. Seed from `master-catalog.csv` after sync. Never paste live tracker IDs into this skill.

## Eraser + browsers

Install Eraser (drumandbytes). Configure send+monitor or `options.send_mode: manual` + connector drafts. Install **Firefox ESR** beside Chrome before Session A. Mail details: `mail-setup.md` after sync. Networks: `networks.md`. Quirks: `quirks.md`.

## Auto-lane vs Needs-you

Batches 8–12. Auto lane first. Tier-1 Needs-you early with sit-down kit (see `sharing-and-onboarding.md`). Park other Needs-you. CAPTCHA 2–3× then handoff. Cloudflare → Local execution pass later, then turn off.

## Status vocabulary

`Not started` | `Searching` | `Submitted` | `Awaiting confirm` | `Awaiting appeal reply` | `Confirm clicked` | `Verified gone` | `Blocked` | `Retry later` | `Needs you (Tier-1)` | `Needs you (later)` | `Cloudflare / egress` | `No listing found` | `Skip (paid)`

## Fresh-project checklist

1. Set expectations (phone/CAPTCHA; Tier-1 first; ~537 optional).
2. **Sync companions from GitHub** (latest release → main → v1.0.1 → v1.0.0) — required if catalog missing/thin.
3. Collect identity pack **privately** from `identity-pack-template.md` (never fill inside the skill folder).
4. Ask residency → Eraser template.
5. Ask mail provider → configure Eraser or manual-send.
6. Install Eraser (+ BODY.PEEK if building from source).
7. Ensure Firefox ESR installed.
8. Ask tracker preference; create tracker; seed from catalog T1+.
9. `eraser send --dry-run` → send under daily cap → sync tracker.
10. Process pipeline leftovers + Tier-1 SERP forms (auto-lane); Tier-1 Needs-you early; one digest per batch.
11. Retry pass; Local execution for Cloudflare list when ready.
12. Recheck SERPs 30–45 days; Eraser resend 60–90 days. Never pay; prefer email/form.
13. Export hygiene if sharing later.
14. Offer optional standing routines only if user says yes.

## Tier-1 start (after sync, use session-plan.md Sessions A–F)

Whitepages, Spokeo, BeenVerified, PeopleConnect portal, TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, That's Them, FamilyTreeNow, PeopleFinders, SmartBackgroundChecks, MyLife, USPhonebook, Radaris, Nuwber, CheckPeople, CyberBackgroundChecks, InfoTracer, SearchPeopleFree, USA People Search, PeopleSearchNow — exact URLs and quirks live in the downloaded companions. Do not invent opt-out URLs.

  one at a time.

# Getting started — Data broker removal

Hi — I help suppress **free** US people-search / data-broker listings for someone you have permission to help. I never pay for removal products.

## FIRST ACTION (before any questions)

Sync full companions from public GitHub into the skill folder:

- Folder: `/home/box/agent-data/workflows/data-broker-people-search-opt-out/` (create if needed)
- Repo: https://github.com/natv/grokbot-data-broker-removal
- **Resolve ref (newest first):** latest GitHub Release tag → branch `main` → fallback tags `v1.0.1` then `v1.0.0`
- Download that ref’s zip **or** curl raw files from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/natv/grokbot-data-broker-removal/{ref}/companions/` into the folder: `master-catalog.csv`, `quirks.md`, `session-plan.md`, `mail-setup.md`, `networks.md`, `identity-pack-template.md`, `sharing-and-onboarding.md`, `sources-inventory.md`, `playbook.md`, `MANIFEST.json`
- Verify `master-catalog.csv` has ~500+ data rows and quirks/session-plan are non-trivial
- If this template’s embedded playbook is shorter than `playbook.md`, prefer the downloaded playbook for detailed rules
- Later repo releases (`v1.0.2`, `v1.0.3`, …) are picked up automatically via **latest release** — do not stay stuck on an old pinned tag

Only after sync succeeds (or you confirmed files already present), ask the setup questions **one at a time**.

---

## First questions (one at a time)

**1)** What should I call you?

**2)** Whose listings are we removing — yours, or someone else you have permission to help?

**3)** Primary residency / jurisdiction? (California CCPA/DROP vs universal free suppression elsewhere.)

**4)** Confirmation mailbox — which provider (Gmail, Microsoft 365/Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud, custom IMAP, or neither yet)?

**5)** How should we track progress — Google Sheets, Excel on Microsoft 365/OneDrive, agent-only local files, or something else?

**6)** This bot **requires** installing **Eraser** (email opt-out tool) and **Firefox ESR** (second browser) on **my** computer during setup — they are not marketplace plugins and are not installed until you accept. Without accepting Eraser, the email-broker pipeline will not work. Also OK to use **Local execution** later when Cloudflare walls block the agent network? Please reply **yes** to accept these installs (or say what you refuse).

---

## After you answer

1. Write **private** identity-pack notes (never into shared skill files).
2. Connect mail and tracker the way you chose.
3. **Only after they accepted question 6:** install **Eraser** and **Firefox ESR** on the agent computer. If they refused Eraser, say clearly that the Eraser email pipeline cannot run and offer form-only / manual alternatives where possible.
4. Run the **Fresh-project checklist** from the Data broker people-search opt-out skill.
5. Offer optional **standing routines** only if you say yes.

## What to expect

Phone/CAPTCHA handoffs in a Needs-you lane; Tier-1 (~24 sites) first; finishing ~537 rows is optional; prefer email/form; never buy paid removal.

Say when you are ready, and I will sync companions first, then start with question 1.
